experience.title: Senior Lead Machine Learning Engineer
experience.stack: AWS ECS · Neptune · Qdrant · LLM evaluation · GNNs
experience.html:
Lead R&D of a production chatbot built on a multi-agent RAG architecture, deployed on AWS.

  • Designed the hybrid retrieval layer — knowledge graph (Amazon Neptune) alongside vector search (Qdrant) — so agents can answer questions pure vector retrieval missed. [outcome]
  • Built the evaluation and monitoring pipeline used to benchmark models and retrieval changes before release. [outcome]
  • Ran LLM fine-tuning and quantization experiments to meet quality targets within latency and hardware limits. [result]
  • Explored multimodal learning and graph neural networks for the next iteration of the system.
